Personal Information Removal is only available on Mac and Windows
Repeatedly scans many data broker sites that sell your information
Find and remove your personal information from data broker sites around the web. DuckDuckGo re-scans regularly to minimize the risk of your info reappearing.
Your info stays on your device, not our servers
Unlike other services, the removal process happens entirely on your device, not remote servers — your device stores the personal information you provide during setup and initiates removal requests.
We automate many removals & help you manually remove the rest

Let us help handle the time, effort, and complexity typically required to get your details removed. We scan for your info, request its removal where possible, then receive and handle confirmation emails for you.
Monitor removal progress in real time
It can take a while for sites to update, so we made it easy to keep tabs on progress of ongoing removals and see the personal info we\'ve removed in real time on your personal dashboard.
